var faqTabDetails =[{"cc-fin":[{"sectionName":"Account registration","questions":[{"answer":"

Registering your Synchrony credit card(s) offers you total control over online account management.

Quickly and easily track account activity, schedule payments, receive e-statements and more — anytime, anywhere, from your computer or mobile device.

You can also take advantage of other great features like access to our convenient MySynchrony mobile app and free credit score monitoring.

","prompt":"Why register my Synchrony credit card account(s)?"},{"answer":"

To register any Synchrony store credit card or Synchrony program card, you will need

  • Full account number: It's on the front of your card, on the top-right corner of your monthly billing statement, and on the paper that your card was attached to when it was mailed
  • Last 4 digits of the primary account holder's Social Security Number
  • Date of birth

Register online now.

","prompt":"How do I register my credit card account(s)?"},{"answer":"Your account number is the number on the front or back of your card, on the top right corner of your monthly billing statement, and on the paper that your card was attached to when it was mailed.","prompt":"Where do I find my account number?"}]},{"sectionName":"New Sign in experience","questions":[{"answer":"

There’s a Sign in button. Select that link to sign in to your account.

","prompt":"How do I sign in?"},{"answer":"

Synchrony is updating our systems that will now allow you to have one username and password to manage your participating Synchrony accounts.

","prompt":"Why are you asking me to create a new sign in?"},{"answer":"

The rules for username are the following:
6-50 characters allowed
Alphanumeric values
No spaces or accents accepted
Special characters allowed- @, -, _, ., $, !, ()
Email address accepted

The password rules are the following:
7-64 characters allowed
At least one numerical value
At least one letter
At least one uppercase
At least one lowercase
At least one special character

Special characters allowed- !, #, $, *, +, -, ., :, ;, =, ?, @, ^, _, , `, |, ~, ,

","prompt":"What are the new username/password credential rules?"},{"answer":"

As long as the username is unique and not currently being used by another account holder, you can use your same username. However, you must adhere to updated password rules (see above question).

","prompt":"Can I use my existing username and password?"},{"answer":"

Select the “Add Synchrony Account to Manager” option and follow the prompts to associate your other accounts.

","prompt":"What do I do if I don’t see all of my accounts?"},{"answer":"

Please contact Synchrony with the phone number on the back of your card or on your statement.

","prompt":"What do I do if I see an account that isn’t mine?"},{"answer":"

No, once the new sign in experience has been fully rolled out, you only need to register once to access your eligible Synchrony accounts. Some accounts are excluded.

","prompt":"Do I have to register all of my accounts?"},{"answer":"

You can still access your account with the existing URL for now, but we encourage you to update your bookmarks to www.synchrony.com/signin.

","prompt":"I have bookmarked different sites for each of my accounts; can I still use those pages?"},{"answer":"

No the registration is limited to the Primary Account holder on a given account.

","prompt":"Can authorized users or joint account holders create a sign in?"},{"answer":"

No. Viewing eBills through your bank's website doesn't use your Synchrony username or password, so nothing will change for you.

","prompt":"If I use eBill through my bank, will my Synchrony password change affect that?"},{"answer":"

For password managers: Yes, please update your password for synchrony.com/login with any password managers you use
For financial aggregators (e.g., Mint, Credit Karma, Quicken, Plaid, etc): No changes are necessary at this time. We will work with these third parties in a future phase. You'll be notified when it's time to update in the coming months.

","prompt":"Do I need to update my password in other aggregators or password management tools?"},{"answer":"

Reset your username

","prompt":"What if I can’t remember my username?"},{"answer":"

Reset your password

","prompt":"What if I can’t remember my password?"},{"answer":"

Reset your security questions

","prompt":"What if I can’t remember my answers to the security questions?"},{"answer":"Contact us by phone at the number on the back of your card. Once you have validated your identity and listened to your account summary say, “Online Assistance” to hear a review of the steps needed to register and sign in to your account.","prompt":"What if I’m still having sign in issues?"},{"answer":"

1. If you have created a username and password since October 7, 2025, you are already using the most current sign in experience.

2. If your password credentials follow these rules, you may likely be using the most current sign in experience:

The rules for username:
6-50 characters allowed
Alphanumeric values
No spaces or accents accepted
Special characters allowed- @, -, _, ., $, !, ()
Email address accepted

The rules for passwords:
7-64 characters allowed
At least one numerical value
At least one letter
At least one uppercase
At least one lowercase
At least one special character

Special characters allowed- !, #, $, *, +, -, ., :, ;, =, ?, @, ^, _, , `, |, ~, ,

3. If you are still not sure if you have completed the sign in experience, hit “Continue” and follow the online prompts.

","prompt":"How do I know if I need to complete the new sign in experience?"},{"answer":"

Visit synchrony.com/register

Review Username and Password Credential Rules

All payments must be made on monthly due date to avoid late fees.","prompt":"What is an equal payment promotion, and how does it work?"},{"answer":"

With a deferred interest promotion, a minimum monthly payment is required, and varies based on your balance and account terms. No interest will be charged on the promotional purchase if you pay the purchase amount in full within the applicable promotional period.

Interest will still accrue at the standard rate for your account. But it is only assessed if you don’t pay the purchase balance within the promotional period. If you only make the minimum payments, you may not pay off your purchase by the end of the promo period. To avoid accrued interest, you must pay in full before the end of the promotional period.

","prompt":"What is a deferred interest promotion, and how does it work?"},{"answer":"

With a fixed pay promotion, a reduced APR is charged on the promotional purchase from the purchase date, and the same fixed payment amount is required monthly.

Interest is assessed on the promotional purchase at the reduced APR, and equal payments are required until the promotion is paid in full. Example: 7.9% APR for 24 months until paid in full.

","prompt":"What is a fixed pay promotion, and how does it work?"},{"answer":"

We calculate the interest charge on your account separately for each balance type. We do this by applying the daily rate to the daily balance for each day in the billing cycle. A separate daily balance is calculated for the following balance types, as applicable: purchases and balances subject to different interest rates, plans or special promotions. See below for more details on how this works.

  1. How to get the daily balance:
    We take the starting balance each day, add any new charges and fees, and subtract any payments or credits. This gives us the daily balance. Debt cancellation fees, if any, and late payment
  2. How to get the daily interest amount:
    We multiply each daily balance by the daily rate that applies.
  3. How to get the starting balance for the next day:
    We add the daily interest amount in step 2 to the daily balance from step 1.
  4. How to get the interest charge for the billing cycle:
    We add all the daily interest amounts that were charged during the billing cycle.

We charge a minimum of $2.00 of interest in any billing cycle in which you owe interest. Interest, as calculated above, is added as applicable to each balance type. Minimum interest charges in excess of the calculated interest are treated as a new purchase.

You can track your order via the link included in your dispatch email (make sure you double-check this hasn't ended up in your junk folder).

\n

Not received a dispatch email? The below might help.

\n

Orders placed before 11pm Monday - Thursday using our Next Day Delivery service can arrive any time up to 8pm the following day. Orders placed after 11pm Thursday, Friday and Saturday will be dispatched on Sunday.

\n

Standard delivery can take up to 4 working days.

"},{"question":"How can I return an item?","answer":"
\n

Our full returns policy can be found here.

"},{"question":"How can I exchange an item for a different size?","answer":"

To return your order for an exchange simply head to our returns portal here then select “Exchange” from the Return Option drop down and complete the field with the item Code, Colour and Size to request your exchange and send everything back to us using our returns service. Please note we can only exchange for the same item in another size. If you request an item that is out of stock then a refund will automatically be processed instead.

\n

Alternatively, if you've paid by credit or debit card you can also pop down to your local Footasylum store and our team will be happy to help.

\n

Unfortunately, we can only offer exchanges within the UK.

"},{"question":"Where is my refund?","answer":"

If you’ve returned something to us for a refund, it can take up to 14 days to process your return once we receive it into our warehouse.

\n

Once the refund is processed, it can take up to 10 working days to show in your account.

\n

If you’ve paid by PayPal or LayBuy, it can also take up to 10 to working days.

"},{"question":"My courier said my parcel arrived, but I don't have it:","answer":"

Before contacting us please make sure your order hasn’t been left in a safe place or with a neighbour.\n

\n

If your order hasn’t been left elsewhere please contact us with your order number and email address and we can assist you.

\n
If there is an item missing from your order or you have received the incorrect items so we can resolve the issue.
"},{"question":"Corporate Media Enquiries","answer":"

For corporate media enquiries, please contact FootAsylum@sodali.com.

\n

Please note, this email address is not monitored for customer enquiries.

\nDiscover the latest kid's trainers and streetwear for kid's from some of the biggest streetwear and activewear brands in the world.\n

Whether you're looking for the hottest kid's Jordan 1s to take your look to the next level or you want to invest in a classic pair of women's Air Force 1s you'll find your new favourite trainers at Footasylum. Or if you're looking for the perfect women's slides for those off-duty days we've got slides and sandals from adidas Originals and must-have Crocs.\n

\n
\n

\nWhen it comes to the latest kid's clothing, we've got you covered with women's tracksuits, t-shirts, leggings and more. From matching sets from Fórena to easy to style women's jeans from Tommy Jeans weve got the perfect look for every day.\n

\n
\n
